candidate_statements.name: reverse_cancellation
candidate_statements.exact_statement: W(x) + W(T(x)) = 0 whenever T and T^2 are defined
candidate_statements.motivation: T^2(x) = x + W(x) + W(T(x)). The only simple algebraic simplification is cancellation of the two reverse terms, which would give T^2(x) = x.
candidate_statements.relevant_domain: integers with a defined two-step reverse-plus-add successor
candidate_statements.expected_yield: an exact two-step identity T^2 = id, the reverse analog of Juggler T^2 < n
candidate_statements.cheapest_falsifier: the first frozen-window seed with W(x) + W(T(x)) != 0
candidate_statements.failure_mechanism: The second reverse does not cancel the first: W(1)=1 and W(2)=-2, so W(x)+W(T(x))=-1 and T^2(1)=0 != 1.

candidate_statements.name: two_step_sign_preservation
candidate_statements.exact_statement: sign(T^2(x)) = sign(x) for x != 0 with T^2 defined
candidate_statements.motivation: If two-step reverse-plus-add were a size-simplifying composition, it should at least preserve sign. This is the weakest exact Class-A relation that is not a reopened ranking template.
candidate_statements.relevant_domain: nonzero integers with a defined two-step successor
candidate_statements.expected_yield: a sign law explaining two-step collapse versus growth
candidate_statements.cheapest_falsifier: the smallest nonzero frozen seed whose two-step image has a different sign
candidate_statements.failure_mechanism: Two-step reverse-plus-add changes sign: 1 -> 2 -> 0 has sign 1 -> 0.

candidate_statements.name: two_step_length_plus_one
candidate_statements.exact_statement: bt_length(T^2(x)) <= bt_length(x) + 1 whenever T^2 is defined
candidate_statements.motivation: Reverse-plus-add is a digit-wise sum of an itinerary and its reverse, so one step can create at most one extra trit. The strongest two-step length law that is not the trivial iterated bound +2 is that two steps still create at most one trit.
candidate_statements.relevant_domain: integers with a defined two-step successor
candidate_statements.expected_yield: an exact length obstruction from reverse-add carry
candidate_statements.cheapest_falsifier: the first frozen seed whose two-step canonical length grows by 2 or more
